recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中一顆遠大於周圍顆粒球的巨大細胞，單一多分葉、互相重疊的核，加上大量細緻紫紅色顆粒的胞質，這是成熟巨核細胞（megakaryocyte）的典型外觀；周圍可見嗜中性球與骨髓球作為大小對照。
features: Very large cell, many times the diameter of adjacent neutrophils
Single hyperlobated nucleus with overlapping, connected lobes and coarse chromatin
Abundant cytoplasm filled with fine azurophilic (purple) granules, consistent with a granular megakaryocyte
No discrete separate nuclei, distinguishing it from an osteoclast
Background of neutrophils, a myelocyte, a nucleated cell, and crenated red cells in a marrow aspirate
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a large megakaryocyte with a single, multilobated nucleus composed of overlapping lobes and abundant, finely granular pink-purple cytoplasm. Surrounding cells include segmented and band neutrophils, a granulocytic precursor, and an erythroid or lymphoid cell, providing a size reference. The megakaryocyte shows normal lobation without hypolobation, separated nuclear lobes, or small size. Findings represent a normal mature granular megakaryocyte.

ddx.vs: Osteoclasts contain multiple separate, uniform round nuclei rather than a single lobulated nucleus.
Dysplastic forms are small or hypolobated (micromegakaryocytes, mononuclear forms) or have widely separated nuclei, unlike this well-lobated cell.
Tumor cells and histiocytes lack the dense fine azurophilic granular cytoplasm and characteristic lobulated megakaryocytic nucleus.
